role_text:
Director of Trust & Safety — consumer social app, 40M monthly users

You will own the systems and the people that keep the platform from
becoming unusable: content policy, enforcement tooling, escalation paths
for real-world harm, and the relationship with law enforcement and
regulators. You will build and lead a team of 12 across policy,
operations and investigations.

We need someone who has made hard calls under time pressure with
incomplete information, who understands that policy without tooling is a
wish, and who can testify credibly if it comes to that.
core_shape: Designing and operating real-time risk containment systems for user-generated networks, where policy rules must be translated into automated enforcement tooling, escalated for real-world harm, and defended before regulators under high ambiguity and time pressure.

pools.name: Tech Content Moderation & Platform Integrity
pools.transfer_logic: They designed content policies, built automated moderation tooling, managed law enforcement escalations, and led cross-functional ops teams for user-generated platforms.
tells: Pure policy writer with no hands-on tooling or ops leadership
Never managed law enforcement or regulator escalations

pools.name: Marketplace Trust & Consumer Protection
pools.transfer_logic: They enforced transaction and user safety policies, built automated fraud and abuse detection tooling, handled real-world harm escalations, and navigated regulatory scrutiny for two-sided platforms.
tells: Focused only on payment fraud without user safety or harm policy experience
No experience with content moderation or community guidelines

pools.name: Financial Crime & AML Operations
pools.transfer_logic: They translated regulatory and risk policies into real-time automated enforcement systems, managed high-stakes escalations with law enforcement and regulators, and made binding decisions under incomplete data at scale.
tells: Pure compliance paperwork role with no hands-on tooling or real-time ops
Only worked in traditional banking with legacy batch processing
Never handled user-facing harm or community policy enforcement

pools.name: Cybersecurity Incident Response & Threat Operations
pools.transfer_logic: They ran real-time containment playbooks, built and tuned detection and response tooling, managed crisis escalation paths, and interfaced with law enforcement and regulators during active threats.
tells: Pure infrastructure or network security without user-facing harm or policy enforcement experience
Never handled regulatory testimony or content/community risk
Only managed internal IT incidents, not public-facing platform threats

pools.name: Gaming Player Safety & Anti-Abuse
pools.transfer_logic: They designed and enforced real-time behavioral policies, built automated moderation and anti-abuse tooling, managed law enforcement escalations for threats and harassment, and operated under high-volume high-pressure conditions.
tells: Focused only on technical anti-cheat without policy or harm escalation experience
Never managed law enforcement or regulatory relations
Only handled small-scale indie titles without real-time ops infrastructure

pools.name: Telecom & ISP Abuse Operations
pools.transfer_logic: They operated automated abuse detection and takedown systems, processed law enforcement and regulatory requests at massive scale, and enforced network and content policies under strict compliance frameworks.
tells: Pure network engineering or legal compliance without hands-on policy-to-tooling translation
Never led real-time ops teams or managed crisis escalation paths
Only handled backend infrastructure abuse, not user-generated content or community harm
